description: rootpath safety guard: no real remediation without a prior dry run, nothing during a change freeze

hooks.command: FALKORDB_URL="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_FALKORDB_URL" ONCALL_GRAPH="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_GRAPH" ROOTPATH_PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" sh -c 'command -v rootpath >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec rootpath "$@" || exec uv run --quiet --directory "$ROOTPATH_PLUGIN_ROOT" rootpath "$@"' rootpath guard
